# Benchmark

This benchmark:

- times DuckHTS `bcftools_score()` against `bcftools +score`
- compares per-sample score outputs with numeric tolerance

# Run

`make bench-score`

Override stress size with `SCORE_BENCH_ROWS` (number of VCF variants) and
repeats with `SCORE_BENCH_RUNS`.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

drv <- duckdb::duckdb(config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true"))
con <- dbConnect(drv, dbdir = ":memory:")

ext_path <- normalizePath("build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension", mustWork = TRUE)
DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf("LOAD '%s';", gsub("\\\\", "/", ext_path)))
DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4;")

bcftools_bin <- Sys.getenv("BCFTOOLS_BIN", unset = Sys.which("bcftools"))
score_plugin_zip <- Sys.getenv(
  "SCORE_PLUGIN_ZIP",
  unset = normalizePath("score_1.22-20250819.zip")
)
bench_rows <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_ROWS", unset = "100000"))
bench_runs <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_RUNS", unset = "3"))
n_samples <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_SAMPLES", unset = "10"))
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
shell_quote <- function(x) shQuote(x, type = "sh")

sql_string <- function(x) {
  sprintf("'%s'", gsub("'", "''", x, fixed = TRUE))
}

score_plugin_path <- function() {
  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "score_1.22-20250819")
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
  candidates <- list.files(
    out_dir,
    pattern = "^score\\.(so|dylib|dll)$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(candidates)) {
    unzip(score_plugin_zip, exdir = out_dir)
    candidates <- list.files(
      out_dir,
      pattern = "^score\\.(so|dylib|dll)$",
      recursive = TRUE,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
  }
  normalizePath(candidates[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
}

write_score_fixture <- function(dir_path, n_variants, n_samples) {
  dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  vcf_path <- file.path(dir_path, "score_input.vcf")
  vcf_gz <- paste0(vcf_path, ".gz")
  summary_path <- file.path(dir_path, "score_summary.tsv")

  # Generate sample names
  sample_names <- sprintf("SAMPLE_%04d", seq_len(n_samples))

  # Generate VCF header
  header_lines <- c(
    "##fileformat=VCFv4.2",
    "##contig=<ID=1,length=250000000>",
    "##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description=\"Genotype\">",
    paste0("#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\t",
           paste(sample_names, collapse = "\t"))
  )

  # Alternate allele pairs
  alleles <- list(c("A", "T"), c("G", "C"), c("C", "A"), c("T", "G"))

  # Generate variant lines
  vcf_lines <- vapply(seq_len(n_variants), function(i) {
    al <- alleles[[(i - 1L) %% length(alleles) + 1L]]
    pos <- i * 10L
    rsid <- sprintf("rs%d", i)
    # Generate random genotypes: 0/0, 0/1, 1/1
    gts <- sample(c("0/0", "0/1", "1/1"), n_samples, replace = TRUE,
                  prob = c(0.5, 0.35, 0.15))
    paste0("1\t", pos, "\t", rsid, "\t", al[1], "\t", al[2],
           "\t.\tPASS\t.\tGT\t", paste(gts, collapse = "\t"))
  }, character(1))

  writeLines(c(header_lines, vcf_lines), vcf_path)

  # Generate matching summary stats (PLINK format)
  summary_lines <- vapply(seq_len(n_variants), function(i) {
    al <- alleles[[(i - 1L) %% length(alleles) + 1L]]
    pos <- i * 10L
    rsid <- sprintf("rs%d", i)
    beta <- round(rnorm(1, 0, 0.5), 4)
    p <- runif(1, 1e-8, 1)
    paste0("1\t", pos, "\t", rsid, "\t", al[2], "\t", beta, "\t", p)
  }, character(1))

  writeLines(c("CHR\tBP\tSNP\tA1\tBETA\tP", summary_lines), summary_path)

  # bgzip + index for bcftools
  DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    sprintf(
      "SELECT * FROM bgzip(%s, output_path := %s, keep := true, overwrite := true)",
      sql_string(vcf_path),
      sql_string(vcf_gz)
    )
  )
  DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    sprintf(
      "SELECT * FROM bcf_index(%s, index_path := %s, threads := 1)",
      sql_string(vcf_gz),
      sql_string(paste0(vcf_gz, ".tbi"))
    )
  )

  list(
    vcf_path = vcf_path,
    vcf_gz = vcf_gz,
    summary_path = summary_path,
    n_variants = n_variants,
    n_samples = n_samples
  )
}

duckdb_score_sql <- function(vcf_path, summary_path) {
  paste0(
    "SELECT * FROM bcftools_score(",
    sql_string(vcf_path), ", ",
    sql_string(summary_path), ", ",
    "use := 'GT', columns := 'PLINK') ",
    "ORDER BY SAMPLE"
  )
}

run_duckdb_bench <- function(vcf_path, summary_path, n = 3L) {
  sql <- duckdb_score_sql(vcf_path, summary_path)
  times <- numeric(n)
  rows <- NA_integer_
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    gc()
    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    out <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql)
    times[i] <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
    rows <- nrow(out)
  }

  data.frame(
    engine = "duckhts",
    runs = n,
    median_sec = stats::median(times),
    min_sec = min(times),
    max_sec = max(times),
    output_rows = rows,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_duckdb_output <- function(vcf_path, summary_path) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, duckdb_score_sql(vcf_path, summary_path))
}

run_bcftools_once <- function(vcf_gz, summary_path, output_path) {
  plugin <- score_plugin_path()
  plugin_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(plugin), mustWork = TRUE)
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS=%s %s +score --use GT -c PLINK -o %s %s %s",
    shell_quote(plugin_dir),
    shell_quote(bcftools_bin),
    shell_quote(output_path),
    shell_quote(vcf_gz),
    shell_quote(summary_path)
  )
  gc()
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  status <- system(cmd, ignore.stdout = TRUE, ignore.stderr = FALSE)
  elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) stop("bcftools +score failed", call. = FALSE)

  # Read bcftools TSV output
  bcf_out <- utils::read.delim(output_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  list(
    elapsed = elapsed,
    output = output_path,
    data = bcf_out
  )
}

compare_outputs <- function(duck_out, bcf_out, rel_tol = 1e-2) {
  # DuckHTS uses double precision; upstream bcftools uses float (32-bit).
  # With large marker counts, accumulated float-vs-double drift is expected.
  # rel_tol = 1e-2 (1%) catches real bugs while accepting float/double drift.
  # Both engines derive PRS name from summary filename (basename minus extensions),
  # so column names should already match. No normalization needed.

  # Ensure same column ordering
  common_cols <- intersect(names(duck_out), names(bcf_out))
  score_cols <- setdiff(common_cols, "SAMPLE")

  merged <- merge(duck_out[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
                  bcf_out[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
                  by = "SAMPLE", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_duck", "_bcf"))

  n_match <- 0L
  n_mismatch <- 0L
  n_only_duck <- sum(is.na(match(duck_out$SAMPLE, bcf_out$SAMPLE)))
  n_only_bcf <- sum(is.na(match(bcf_out$SAMPLE, bcf_out$SAMPLE)))
  max_abs_diff <- 0
  max_rel_diff <- 0

  for (col in score_cols) {
    duck_col <- paste0(col, "_duck")
    bcf_col <- paste0(col, "_bcf")
    if (duck_col %in% names(merged) && bcf_col %in% names(merged)) {
      d <- as.numeric(merged[[duck_col]])
      b <- as.numeric(merged[[bcf_col]])
      abs_diff <- abs(d - b)
      denom <- pmax(abs(d), abs(b), 1.0)
      rel_diff <- abs_diff / denom
      matches <- !is.na(rel_diff) & rel_diff <= rel_tol
      n_match <- n_match + sum(matches, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_mismatch <- n_mismatch + sum(!matches, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_abs_diff <- max(max_abs_diff, max(abs_diff, na.rm = TRUE))
      max_rel_diff <- max(max_rel_diff, max(rel_diff, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  }

  data.frame(
    duck_samples = nrow(duck_out),
    bcf_samples = nrow(bcf_out),
    score_columns = length(score_cols),
    cell_matches = n_match,
    cell_mismatches = n_mismatch,
    only_duck_samples = n_only_duck,
    max_abs_diff = max_abs_diff,
    max_rel_diff = max_rel_diff,
    outputs_match = (n_mismatch == 0L && n_only_duck == 0L),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_benchmark_case <- function(fixture, n = 3L) {
  duck <- run_duckdb_bench(fixture$vcf_path, fixture$summary_path, n = n)
  duck_out <- run_duckdb_output(fixture$vcf_path, fixture$summary_path)

  bcftools_times <- numeric(n)
  bcftools_out <- NULL
  output_rows <- NA_integer_
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    out_tsv <- tempfile("bcftools_score_", fileext = ".tsv")
    run <- run_bcftools_once(fixture$vcf_gz, fixture$summary_path, out_tsv)
    bcftools_times[i] <- run$elapsed
    output_rows <- nrow(run$data)
    if (i == 1L) {
      bcftools_out <- run$data
    }
    unlink(out_tsv, force = TRUE)
  }

  list(
    bench = rbind(
      duck,
      data.frame(
        engine = "bcftools",
        runs = n,
        median_sec = stats::median(bcftools_times),
        min_sec = min(bcftools_times),
        max_sec = max(bcftools_times),
        output_rows = output_rows,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    ),
    compare = compare_outputs(duck_out, bcftools_out)
  )
}
```

## Synthetic Stress Case

```{r synthetic, echo = FALSE}
set.seed(42L)
fixture_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "duckhts_score_benchmark")
fixture <- write_score_fixture(fixture_dir, n_variants = bench_rows, n_samples = n_samples)
bench_case <- run_benchmark_case(fixture, n = bench_runs)

bench_case$bench
```

```{r synthetic-compare, echo = FALSE}
bench_case$compare
```
